title: Residential Painting in Gainesville, FL Homes
description: Residential painting in Gainesville, FL for historic districts, NW bungalows, and newer subdivisions. Own crews, written warranty, and free itemized quotes.
heroIntro: Prep for a century-old Pleasant Street house looks nothing like prep for a Town of Tioga build. We repaint both kinds of Gainesville homes, inside and out, and you stay in yours the whole time.

questions: Do I need to move out while my Gainesville house is painted?
How is painting an older Gainesville home different from a newer one?
Is residential painting in Gainesville covered by a warranty?

sections.h2: Duckpond, NW bungalows, and Haile: three Gainesville house types
body: Gainesville homes fall roughly into three groups, and each has its own trouble spots.

In the historic Duckpond and Pleasant Street districts, plenty of houses have outlived every coat of paint they have ever worn. Expect layered paint, wood that has shrunk and swelled for decades, and windows and doors worth saving. On those houses we remove loose film until the edges hold, sand them smooth, and seal raw wood with primer before color goes on.

The postwar bungalows in NW Gainesville are smaller and simpler, but their eaves, sills, and lower siding boards take a beating from splash-back and gutters. On those, new fascia boards and replacement sills show up on a lot of our estimates.

Haile Plantation and Town of Tioga houses are newer, so the work leans toward planning over repair: matching the trim color already there, staying inside the community's guidelines, and swapping tired builder flat paint for a finish you can actually wipe down.

sections.h2: One Gainesville estimate for indoors and out
body: A call about peeling fascia often turns into a conversation about the dining room, or the other way around. Both interior work and exterior repaints can live on a single line-item quote that says plainly which surfaces are in and which are out. Then the outside can be booked for Gainesville's drier months and the crew can move inside once the summer storms start. Our general residential painting page explains the full system, and the Gainesville location page lists every neighborhood we cover.

sections.h2: Keeping a Gainesville household running during the work
body: Moving out is unnecessary. The painters carry and cover your furniture themselves, finish a room before opening the next, and tidy up daily, which leaves most of the house free for normal life. Ask about the low-VOC products if you have small kids, pets, or someone on video calls from a home office and want less paint smell.
Outside, we cover plantings, protect walkways, and plan the order of elevations so doors you use every day are back in service quickly.

sections.h2: What goes on a Gainesville house, and how many coats
bullets: 100% acrylic for clapboard, fiber-cement lap siding, and exterior trim
Elastomeric on stucco walls that show hairline movement
A waterborne urethane enamel where hands touch most: doors, railings, cabinets
Never fewer than two complete coats, with a third for bold color shifts or porous surfaces
Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore premium products, called out by name in your quote

body: On the final day, you and the crew lead go room by room and around the outside with a punch list, and nothing gets signed until each item has been fixed. Our outside work is backed by a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, which comes in addition to the paint maker's warranty, and the leftover cans are labelled and left for future touch-ups. Owners of older Gainesville houses who want colors that suit the era can start with our article on historic paint colors in Gainesville.

faqs.q: Will you replace rotten trim on my Gainesville bungalow?
faqs.a: Yes. Replacing rotten trim and fascia is part of prep on bungalows like yours. The crew lead photographs the bad boards during the walkthrough, and the repair gets a separate line on your estimate.

faqs.q: How long will my Gainesville house take, inside and out?
faqs.a: Plan on anywhere between three days and two weeks for an entire interior. The outside of the house usually needs three to seven working days, plus time for the wash and for drying.

faqs.q: Do you help with HOA color rules in newer Gainesville neighborhoods?
faqs.a: Yes. Newer Gainesville subdivisions usually publish a palette, and we can mix to any color on it using the chip or a sample from your siding, then brush out full-size drawdowns for the architectural committee to review.
Yes, there is no charge and no commitment. After the walkthrough, expect your written number within a business day.
